Treehouse Foods (THS) Shareholder Blue Harbour Group LP Boosted Stake by $7.38 Million; As Aspen Aerogels (ASPN) Share Price Declined, Needham Investment Management Raised by $660,000 Its Holding 
April 20, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson 
Needham Investment Management Llc increased its stake in Aspen Aerogels Inc (ASPN) by 37.93% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Needham Investment Management Llc bought 165,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 13.29% with the market. The institutional investor held 600,000 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.93M, up from 435,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Needham Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Aspen Aerogels Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $104.98M market cap company. It closed at $4.44 lastly. It is down 3.16% since April 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 8.39% the S&P500.
